dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe! See? Now the cranes are all coming over!

dialogues.speaker: Kanou
dialogues.text: To think it could be solved like that... Truly remarkable.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe! Waiting around won't get you anywhere!... That sounded pretty insightful, didn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Kanou
dialogues.text: #My thanks, {NICKNAME}, and to you as well, Paimon. I've had a change of heart. A painting that shows only cranes would be far too plain, the sort of subject one puts on a folding screen.

dialogues.speaker: Kanou
dialogues.text: #Yes... I know what this piece must be: "{NICKNAME} and Paimon Summoning the Cranes." Ah, I can already see it taking shape on the scroll! Please, accept these humble gifts.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a second! That's still about cranes!
